description: This PHP source file defines the PurchaseOrderPDFController class, which extends the InventoryPDFController to generate PDF representations of purchase orders within the vtiger CRM system. The class includes methods for constructing header content such as title, column details, addresses, and watermark content, utilizing various helper functions and translating strings.

classes.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class for generating purchase order PDFs, extending inventory PDF functionalities, with methods to build header sections and retrieve watermark content.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Constructs the title for the PDF header, including purchase order number.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnCenter
methods.description: Builds central column data for the PDF header, including contact and vendor names, tracking, and requisition numbers.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Builds right-aligned header columns with dates and addresses, formatted appropriately.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Retrieves the watermark content based on purchase order status.
